title: Especialista em governança de dados
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em governança de dados em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.

Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio.

Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura.

Responsabilidades

Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.

Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):

Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas.

PLR/Bônus: Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação! Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família. title: Marketing designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer

Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours

A letter from our client

Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.

Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.

Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.

In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.

Why this role exists

Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.

The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.

They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.

The role

This position is equal parts:

AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.

On the AI side:

Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.

On the design and development side:

The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.

The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.

Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.

What the role includes

Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency

What our client is looking for

Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset

What they DO NOT want

Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt

Portfolio required

Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.

Their team would like to see:

At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow

What it's like working with them

They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.

There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.

If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Marketing designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer

Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours

A letter from our client

Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.

Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.

Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.

In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.

Why this role exists

Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.

The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.

They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.

The role

This position is equal parts:

AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.

On the AI side:

Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.

On the design and development side:

The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.

The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.

Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.

What the role includes

Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency

What our client is looking for

Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset

What they DO NOT want

Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt

Portfolio required

Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.

Their team would like to see:

At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow

What it's like working with them

They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.

There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.

If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Almoxarife
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Almoxarife em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

Atender às reservas e requisições de materiais, separando e entregando conforme necessidade das áreas internas. Receber materiais conferindo AR (Autorização de Recebimento) e condições físicas dos produtos. Armazenar os materiais em locais apropriados, respeitando critérios de segurança, validade e acessibilidade. Realizar contagens cíclicas e apoiar na execução de inventários físicos. Controlar prazos de validade e integridade dos materiais durante o armazenamento. Apoiar na organização e limpeza do almoxarifado, conforme padrões de 5 S. Lançar movimentações básicas no sistema ERP, com apoio ou sob orientação do Almoxarife II ou do líder. Comunicar divergências ou anomalias nos materiais ou processos ao superior imediato. Apoiar em outras atividades do setor sempre que necessário. Realizar descargas, e movimentações dentro do almoxarifado com o uso de empilhadeira. Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.

Requisitos:

Ensino médio Completo. Habilitação em Empilhadeira (NR 11). Carteira de Habilitação B. Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turno e escala. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Experiência atuando em almoxarifado. Vivência no pacote office, principalmente Excel; Conhecimento em procedimentos de recebimento, conferência e controle de estoque, em sistema ERP (movimentações, baixas, requisições) e em inventário físico e contagem cíclica.

Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio.

Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura.

Responsabilidades

Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. title: Marketing designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer

Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours

A letter from our client

Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.

Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.

Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.

In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.

Why this role exists

Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.

The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.

They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.

The role

This position is equal parts:

AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.

On the AI side:

Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.

On the design and development side:

The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.

The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.

Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.

What the role includes

Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency

What our client is looking for

Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset

What they DO NOT want

Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt

Portfolio required

Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.

Their team would like to see:

At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow

What it's like working with them

They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.

There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.

If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.


2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:
Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration:
6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation:
Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)
Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only:
Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.
What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery:
Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation:
Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency:
Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.
The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese):
Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages.
You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine:
2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility:
Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.
Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine:
You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails:
You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.
What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential:
On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook:
Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew:
No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.
The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination:
Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:
Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

title: Senior revops analyst - churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior revops analyst - churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Contract Type:
Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:
6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.
About the Role We are seeking
a Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churn
to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.
Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.
Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em
Nefrologia!
Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de
Nefrologia
, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.
*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
REQUISITOS
Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.
Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE
(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.
Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.
Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.
Local de Trabalho: REMOTO
Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.
I
MPORTANTE:
MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:
Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.
Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.
Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.
Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.
Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages.
You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine:
2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility:
Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.
Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine:
You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails:
You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.
What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential:
On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook:
Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew:
No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.

Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:
Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

title: Senior revops analyst - churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior revops analyst - churn em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Contract Type:
Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:
6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.
About the Role We are seeking
a Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churn
to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.
Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.
Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em
Nefrologia!
Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de
Nefrologia
, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.
*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
REQUISITOS
Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.
Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE
(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.
Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.
Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.
Local de Trabalho: REMOTO
Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.
I
MPORTANTE:
MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:
Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use
AI coding tools
to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. title: Information technology manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information technology manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Role Overview
Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.
Key Responsibilities
Business Process Engineering
(Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.
Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication:
Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:
Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:
Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.
Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.
Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.
Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.
Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

title: Vacation rental revenue manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation rental revenue manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio. This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.
Compensation: $250 USD per week, paid weekly.
What you'll do: - Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends - Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing - Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts - Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability - Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels - Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions

Nice to have: - Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management - Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting - Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.
To apply, please include: - Your resume - A short note about your relevant experience - Your Linked In profile, if available

title: Oracle goldengate data engineer | senior (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Oracle goldengate data engineer | senior (remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Responsabilidades e atribuições Projetar, desenvolver e sustentar pipelines de dados escaláveis com foco em ingestão via CDC (Change Data Capture) utilizando Oracle Golden Gate; Configurar e administrar replicações de dados em tempo real e quase tempo real entre sistemas origem e ambientes cloud; Garantir consistência, integridade e sincronização dos dados entre origem e destino; Monitorar pipelines de ingestão, atuar em troubleshooting e otimizar performance dos processos CDC; Suportar estratégias de carga full e incremental (delta load); Desenvolver e manter pipelines de processamento de dados utilizando Azure e Databricks (Spark); Implementar transformações seguindo arquitetura moderna de dados no modelo Bronze, Silver e Gold; Otimizar pipelines visando performance, escalabilidade e eficiência de custos; Trabalhar com dados estruturados e semiestruturados para consumo analítico, relatórios e iniciativas de IA/ML; Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos de dados na definição de arquiteturas modernas de Lakehouse; Apoiar iniciativas de governança, catálogo de dados, lineage e compliance; Garantir disponibilidade, confiabilidade, segurança e qualidade dos dados para consumo downstream.
Requisitos e qualificações
Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência prática e sólida com Oracle Golden Gate em processos de ingestão de dados e CDC (Change Data Capture), incluindo replicação em tempo real e quase tempo real; Vivência no desenvolvimento, sustentação e otimização de pipelines de dados escaláveis e distribuídos; Experiência com ecossistema Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake e Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2; Forte conhecimento em Databricks e processamento distribuído utilizando Spark; Experiência em arquiteturas modernas de dados, como Lakehouse, trabalhando com camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold; Vivência com cargas full e incrementais (delta load), garantindo integridade, consistência e sincronização dos dados; Conhecimento em monitoramento de pipelines, troubleshooting, tuning de performance e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud; Experiência com dados estruturados e semiestruturados voltados para analytics, reporting e iniciativas de IA/ML; Conhecimento em governança de dados, catálogo, lineage, segurança e boas práticas de arquitetura corporativa; Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de dados, times analíticos e stakeholders de negócio.
